metricSemantics.membership: Membership counts are read from AppointmentSlotBooking and compared with successful operation counts; raw historical rows are retained separately.
metricSemantics.deadlocks: Recognized database deadlock/serialization conflict codes only; service-level 409 conflicts remain ordinary failed calls.
metricSemantics.latency: Per-call service latency, nearest-rank percentiles. Fixture creation and database readback excluded.
